tEn: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
tZh: Mamba：具有选择性状态空间的线性时间序列建模
sEn: Mamba achieves linear-time sequence modeling with selective state spaces, outperforming Transformers in efficiency and performance across modalities including language, audio, and genomics.
sZh: Mamba通过选择性状态空间实现线性时间序列建模，在语言、音频和基因组学等多个模态上的效率和性能均超越Transformer。
absEn: Foundation models, now powering most of the exciting applications in deep learning, are almost universally based on the Transformer architecture and its core attention module. Many subquadratic-time architectures such as linear attention, gated convolution and recurrent models, and structured state space models (SSMs) have been developed to address Transformers' computational inefficiency on long sequences, but they have not performed as well as attention on important modalities such as language. We identify that a key weakness of such models is their inability to perform content-based reasoning, and make several improvements. First, simply letting the SSM parameters be functions of the input addresses their weakness with discrete modalities, allowing the model to selectively propagate or forget information along the sequence length dimension depending on the current token. Second, even though this change prevents the use of efficient convolutions, we design a hardware-aware parallel algorithm in recurrent mode. We integrate these selective SSMs into a simplified end-to-end neural network architecture without attention or even MLP blocks (Mamba). Mamba enjoys fast inference (5$\times$ higher throughput than Transformers) and linear scaling in sequence length, and its performance improves on real data up to million-length sequences. As a general sequence model backbone, Mamba achieves state-of-the-art performance across several modalities such as language, audio, and genomics. On language modeling, our Mamba-3B model outperforms Transformers of the same size and matches Transformers twice its size, both in pretraining and downstream evaluation.
absZh: 基础模型如今支撑着深度学习中大多数令人兴奋的应用，它们几乎普遍基于Transformer架构及其核心的注意力模块。为了解决Transformer在长序列上的计算效率问题，研究者开发了许多次二次时间架构，如线性注意力、门控卷积和循环模型以及结构化状态空间模型（SSM），但这些模型在语言等重要模态上的表现不如注意力。我们发现这些模型的一个关键弱点在于它们无法进行基于内容的推理，并对此做出了若干改进。首先，让SSM参数成为输入的函数，解决了它们在离散模态上的弱点，使得模型能够根据当前token沿着序列长度维度选择性地传播或遗忘信息。其次，尽管这一改变阻止了高效卷积的使用，我们设计了一种硬件感知的循环模式并行算法。我们将这些选择性SSM集成到一个简化的端到端神经网络架构中，该架构不包含注意力甚至MLP块（Mamba）。Mamba具有快速推理（吞吐量比Transformer高5倍）和序列长度线性扩展的特点，在长达百万长度的真实数据上性能提升。作为一个通用序列模型骨干，Mamba在语言、音频和基因组学等多个模态上取得了最先进的性能。在语言建模方面，我们的Mamba-3B模型在预训练和下游评估中均优于相同大小的Transformer，并与两倍大小的Transformer表现相当。

contrib.en: Proposes selective state space models (SSMs) that allow input-dependent filtering and forgetting, overcoming key weakness of prior LTI SSMs.
contrib.zh: 提出选择性状态空间模型（SSM），支持输入依赖的过滤与遗忘，克服了先前LTI SSM的关键弱点。

contrib.en: Designs a hardware-aware parallel algorithm for the recurrent mode, enabling efficient training and inference with linear scaling in sequence length.
contrib.zh: 设计了面向硬件的并行递归算法，实现序列长度线性时间的高效训练与推理。

contrib.en: Introduces Mamba, a simplified architecture without attention or MLP blocks, achieving 5x higher inference throughput than Transformers.
contrib.zh: 引入Mamba架构，不含注意力或MLP块，推理吞吐量比Transformer高5倍。

contrib.en: Demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across language, audio, and genomics, with Mamba-3B outperforming Transformers of the same size and matching those twice its size.
contrib.zh: 在语言、音频和基因组学上达到最先进性能，Mamba-3B超越同等规模Transformer，媲美两倍规模Transformer。

contrib.en: Shows that selective SSMs enable effective long-context modeling, with performance improving up to million-length sequences.
contrib.zh: 表明选择性SSM能有效建模长上下文，性能在百万级序列长度上持续提升。

contrib.en: Provides open-source model code and pre-trained checkpoints to facilitate further research.
contrib.zh: 开源模型代码和预训练检查点，促进进一步研究。

limits.en: Selection mechanism may reduce performance on continuous signal data where LTI SSMs excel, such as audio and video.
limits.zh: 选择机制可能在LTI SSM擅长的连续信号数据（如音频、视频）上降低性能。

limits.en: Mamba has not been validated at larger scales (e.g., 7B+ parameters) where Transformers are dominant, leaving scalability uncertain.
limits.zh: Mamba未在更大规模（如7B+参数）上验证，可扩展性不确定，而Transformer在该规模占主导地位。

limits.en: The hardware-aware algorithm relies on specific GPU memory hierarchy (e.g., HBM and SRAM), potentially limiting generalizability to other hardware.
limits.zh: 硬件感知算法依赖特定GPU内存层次（如HBM和SRAM），可能限制推广到其他硬件。

limits.en: Mamba lacks the rich ecosystem of Transformer-based models, such as fine-tuning, prompting, and instruction tuning, which may limit practical adoption.
limits.zh: Mamba缺乏基于Transformer模型的丰富生态系统，如微调、提示和指令调优，可能限制实际采用。

limits.en: The input-dependent selection mechanism may introduce training instability or require more careful hyperparameter tuning compared to LTI models.
limits.zh: 输入依赖的选择机制可能引入训练不稳定，或需要比LTI模型更仔细的超参数调优。

items.en: Foundation models, now powering most of the exciting applications in deep learning, are almost universally based on the Transformer architecture and its core attention module. Many subquadratic-time architectures such as linear attention, gated convolution and recurrent models, and structured state space models (SSMs) have been developed to address Transformers’ computational inefficiency on long sequences, but they have not performed as well as attention on important modalities such as language. We identify that a key weakness of such models is their inability to perform content-based reasoning, and make several improvements. First, simply letting the SSM parameters be functions of the input addresses their weakness with discrete modalities, allowing the model to selectively propagate or forget information along the sequence length dimension depending on the current token. Second, even though this change prevents the use of efficient convolutions, we design a hardware-aware parallel algorithm in recurrent mode. We integrate these selective SSMs into a simplified end-to-end neural network architecture without attention or even MLP blocks (Mamba). Mamba enjoys fast inference (5 \times higher throughput than Transformers) and linear scaling in sequence length, and its performance improves on real data up to million-length sequences. As a general sequence model backbone, Mamba achieves state-of-the-art performance across several modalities such as language, audio, and genomics. items.zh: 基础模型如今驱动着深度学习中最激动人心的应用，几乎普遍基于Transformer架构及其核心的注意力模块。许多次二次时间架构（如线性注意力、门控卷积和循环模型，以及结构化状态空间模型（SSM））已被开发出来，以解决Transformer在长序列上的计算低效问题，但在语言等重要模态上，它们的性能仍不如注意力机制。我们发现这类模型的一个关键弱点是无法进行基于内容的推理，并做出了几项改进。首先，仅仅让SSM参数成为输入的函数，就解决了它们在离散模态上的弱点，使得模型能够根据当前token选择性地沿序列长度维度传播或遗忘信息。其次，尽管这一变化阻止了高效卷积的使用，我们设计了一种硬件感知的并行算法，以循环模式运行。我们将这些选择性SSM集成到一个简化的端到端神经网络架构中，无需注意力甚至MLP模块（Mamba）。Mamba拥有快速推理（吞吐量比Transformers高5倍）和序列长度线性缩放，其性能在真实数据上可提升至百万长度序列。作为通用的序列模型骨干，Mamba在语言、音频和基因组学等多种模态上达到了最先进的性能。在语言建模中，我们的Mamba-3B模型在预训练和下游评估中均优于同尺寸Transformers，并可匹配两倍大小的Transformers。

items.en: Foundation models (FMs), or large models pretrained on massive data then adapted for downstream tasks, have emerged as an effective paradigm in modern machine learning. The backbone of these FMs are often sequence models, operating on arbitrary sequences of inputs from a wide variety of domains such as language, images, speech, audio, time series, and genomics. While this concept is agnostic to a particular choice of model architecture, modern FMs are predominantly based on a single type of sequence model: the Transformer and its core attention layer. The efficacy of self-attention is attributed to its ability to route information densely within a context window, allowing it to model complex data. However, this property brings fundamental drawbacks: an inability to model anything outside of a finite window, and quadratic scaling with respect to the window length. An enormous body of research has appeared on more efficient variants of attention to overcome these drawbacks, but often at the expense of the very properties that make it effective. As of yet, none of these variants have been shown to be empirically effective at scale across domains.
items.zh: 基础模型（FMs），即在海量数据上预训练然后适应下游任务的大模型，已成为现代机器学习中一个有效的范式。这些FMs的主干通常是序列模型，处理来自各种领域的任意输入序列，例如语言、图像、语音、音频、时间序列和基因组学。尽管这一概念与具体的模型架构选择无关，但现代FMs主要基于一种序列模型：Transformer及其核心注意力层。自注意力的有效性归因于它能够在上下文窗口内密集路由信息，从而对复杂数据建模。然而，这一特性带来了根本性的缺点：无法对有限窗口之外的任何内容建模，并且相对于窗口长度呈二次缩放。为了克服这些缺点，大量关于更高效注意力变体的研究已经出现，但往往以牺牲使其有效的特性为代价。迄今为止，这些变体都没有被证明在跨领域的规模上是经验有效的。

items.en: Recently, structured state space sequence models (SSMs) have emerged as a promising class of architectures for sequence modeling. These models can be interpreted as a combination of recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs), with inspiration from classical state space models. This class of models can be computed very efficiently as either a recurrence or convolution, with linear or near-linear scaling in sequence length. Additionally, they have principled mechanisms for modeling long-range dependencies in certain data modalities, and have dominated benchmarks such as the Long Range Arena. Many flavors of SSMs have been successful in domains involving continuous signal data such as audio and vision. However, they have been less effective at modeling discrete and information-dense data such as text.
items.zh: 最近，结构化状态空间序列模型（SSMs）作为一种有前途的序列建模架构类别出现。这些模型可以解释为循环神经网络（RNNs）和卷积神经网络（CNNs）的组合，灵感来自经典的状态空间模型。这类模型可以很高效地作为循环或卷积计算，序列长度呈线性或近线性缩放。此外，它们具有在某些数据模态中建模长距离依赖的原则性机制，并主导了Long Range Arena等基准测试。许多SSMs的变体在涉及连续信号数据的领域（如音频和视觉）取得了成功。然而，它们在建模离散且信息密集的数据（如文本）方面效果较差。

items.en: We propose a new class of selective state space models, that improves on prior work on several axes to achieve the modeling power of Transformers while scaling linearly in sequence length.
items.zh: 我们提出了一类新的选择性状态空间模型，它在多个方面改进了先前的工作，以在序列长度上线性缩放的同时实现Transformer的建模能力。

items.en: First, we identify a key limitation of prior models: the ability to efficiently select data in an input-dependent manner (i.e. focus on or ignore particular inputs). Building on intuition based on important synthetic tasks such as selective copy and induction heads, we design a simple selection mechanism by parameterizing the SSM parameters based on the input. This allows the model to filter out irrelevant information and remember relevant information indefinitely.
items.zh: 首先，我们识别出先前模型的一个关键局限性：以输入依赖的方式高效选择数据的能力（即关注或忽略特定输入）。基于对重要合成任务（如选择性复制和归纳头）的直觉，我们通过基于输入参数化SSM参数来设计一个简单的选择机制。这使得模型能够过滤掉不相关信息，并无限期记住相关信息。

items.en: This simple change poses a technical challenge for the computation of the model; in fact, all prior SSM models must be time- and input-invariant in order to be computationally efficient. We overcome this with a hardware-aware algorithm that computes the model recurrently with a scan instead of convolution, but does not materialize the expanded state in order to avoid IO access between different levels of the GPU memory hierarchy. The resulting implementation is faster than previous methods both in theory (scaling linearly in sequence length, compared to pseudo-linear for all convolution-based SSMs) and on modern hardware (up to \(3 	imes\) faster on A100 GPUs).
items.zh: 这一简单变化给模型的计算带来了技术挑战；事实上，所有先前的SSM模型必须是时不变和输入不变的，以便在计算上高效。我们通过一种硬件感知的算法来克服这一点，该算法使用扫描（scan）而非卷积以循环方式计算模型，但不具体化扩展状态，以避免GPU内存层次结构中不同层级之间的IO访问。最终的实现无论在理论上（序列长度线性缩放，而所有基于卷积的SSM为伪线性）还是在现代硬件上（在A100 GPU上快达\(3 	imes\)）都优于先前方法。

items.en: We simplify prior deep sequence model architectures by combining the design of prior SSM architectures with the MLP block of Transformers into a single block, leading to a simple and homogenous architecture design (Mamba) incorporating selective state spaces.
items.zh: 我们将先前SSM架构的设计与Transformer的MLP块结合到一个单一的块中，从而简化了先前的深度序列模型架构，产生了包含选择性状态空间的简单且同质的架构设计（Mamba）。

items.en: Selective SSMs, and by extension the Mamba architecture, are fully recurrent models with key properties that make them suitable as the backbone of general foundation models operating on sequences. (i) High quality: selectivity brings strong performance on dense modalities such as language and genomics. (ii) Fast training and inference: computation and memory scales linearly in sequence length during training, and unrolling the model autoregressively during inference requires only constant time per step since it does not require a cache of previous elements. (iii) Long context: the quality and efficiency together yield performance improvements on real data up to sequence length 1M.
items.zh: 选择性SSM，以及由此扩展的Mamba架构，是完全循环模型，具有使其适合作为处理序列的通用基础模型骨干的关键特性。(i) 高质量：选择性能在密集模态（如语言和基因组学）上带来强大的性能。(ii) 快速训练与推理：在训练期间，计算和内存随序列长度线性扩展，而在推理期间，模型自回归展开仅需每步恒定时间，因为它不需要缓存之前的元素。(iii) 长上下文：质量和效率共同提升了真实数据中高达1M序列长度的性能。

items.en: We empirically validate Mamba’s potential as a general sequence FM backbone, in both pretraining quality and domain-specific task performance, on several types of modalities and settings:
items.zh: 我们通过多种模态和设置，在预训练质量和特定领域任务性能上，实证验证了Mamba作为通用序列基础模型骨干的潜力。

items.en: Synthetics. On important synthetic tasks such as copying and induction heads that have been proposed as being key to large language models, Mamba not only solves them easily but can extrapolate solutions indefinitely long ( \(>\) 1M tokens).
items.zh: 合成任务。在重要的合成任务（如复制和归纳头）上，这些任务被认为是大型语言模型的关键，Mamba不仅能够轻松解决它们，而且可以无限长地外推解（超过1M个词元）。

items.en: Audio and Genomics. Mamba out-performs prior state-of-the-art models such as SaShiMi, Hyena, and Transformers on modeling audio waveforms and DNA sequences, both in pretraining quality and downstream metrics (e.g. reducing FID on a challenging speech generation dataset by more than half). In both settings, its performance improves with longer context up to million-length sequences.
items.zh: 音频与基因组学。在对音频波形和DNA序列进行建模方面，Mamba在预训练质量和下游指标（例如，在具有挑战性的语音生成数据集上，FID降低了一半以上）上均优于先前的先进模型，如SaShiMi、Hyena和Transformer。在这两种设置中，其性能随着上下文长度增加到百万长度的序列而提升。

items.en: Language Modeling. Mamba is the first linear-time sequence model that truly achieves Transformer-quality performance, both in pre-training perplexity and downstream evaluations. With scaling laws up to 1B parameters, we show that Mamba exceeds the performance of a large range of baselines, including very strong modern Transformer training recipes based on LLaMA. Our Mamba language model has 5 \(\times\) generation throughput compared to Transformers of similar size, and Mamba-3B's quality matches that of Transformers twice its size (e.g., 4 points higher avg. on common sense reasoning compared to Pythia-3B and even exceeding Pythia-7B).
items.zh: 语言建模。Mamba是首个真正达到Transformer质量性能的线性时间序列模型，在预训练困惑度和下游评估中均表现优异。通过高达1B参数的缩放定律，我们展示了Mamba超越了大量基线模型的性能，包括基于LLaMA的极强现代Transformer训练方案。我们的Mamba语言模型在生成吞吐量上比相同规模的Transformer高5倍，而Mamba-3B的质量与两倍规模的Transformer相当（例如，在常识推理上平均比Pythia-3B高4个百分点，甚至超过Pythia-7B）。

items.zh: 模型代码和预训练检查点已在 https://github.com/state-spaces/mamba 开源。

items.en: Structured state space sequence models (S4) are a recent class of sequence models for deep learning that are broadly related to RNNs, CNNs, and classical state space models. They are inspired by a particular continuous system (1) that maps a 1-dimensional function or sequence \(x(t) \in \mathbb{R} \mapsto y(t) \in \mathbb{R}\) through an implicit latent state \(h(t) \in \mathbb{R}^{N}\).
items.zh: 结构化状态空间序列模型（S4）是最近一类用于深度学习的序列模型，与RNN、CNN和经典状态空间模型广泛相关。它们受到一个特定连续系统（1）的启发，该系统通过一个隐式潜在状态\(h(t) \in \mathbb{R}^{N}\)将一维函数或序列\(x(t) \in \mathbb{R} \mapsto y(t) \in \mathbb{R}\)进行映射。

items.en: Concretely, S4 models are defined with four parameters \(\Delta, \bm{A}, \bm{B}, \bm{C})\, which define a sequence-to-sequence transformation in two stages.
items.zh: 具体来说，S4模型由四个参数\(\Delta, \bm{A}, \bm{B}, \bm{C})\定义，这些参数分两个阶段定义序列到序列的变换。

items.en: The first stage transforms the “continuous parameters” \(\Delta, \bm{A}, \bm{B})\ to “discrete parameters” \(\overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}})\ through fixed formulas \(\overline{\bm{A}} = f_{A}(\Delta, \bm{A})\) and \(\overline{\bm{B}} = f_{B}(\Delta, \bm{A}, \bm{B})\), where the pair \(f_{A}, f_{B})\ is called a discretization rule. Various rules can be used such as the zero-order hold (ZOH) defined in equation (4).
items.zh: 第一阶段通过固定公式\(\overline{\bm{A}} = f_{A}(\Delta, \bm{A})\)和\(\overline{\bm{B}} = f_{B}(\Delta, \bm{A}, \bm{B})\)将“连续参数”\(\Delta, \bm{A}, \bm{B})\转换为“离散参数”\(\overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}})\，其中\(f_{A}, f_{B})\称为离散化规则。可以使用各种规则，例如方程（4）中定义的零阶保持器（ZOH）。

items.en: Discretization has deep connections to continuous-time systems which can endow them with additional properties such as resolution invariance and automatically ensuring that the model is properly normalized. It also has connections to gating mechanisms of RNNs which we will revisit in Section 3.5. However, from a mechanical point of view discretization can simply be viewed as the first step of the computation graph in the forward pass of an SSM. Alternate flavors of SSMs can bypass the discretization step and parameterize \(\overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}})\ directly instead, which may be easier to reason about.
items.zh: 离散化与连续时间系统有深刻联系，可以赋予模型额外性质，如分辨率不变性和自动确保模型被正确归一化。它还与RNN的门控机制有关，我们将在第3.5节中重新讨论。然而，从机械的角度来看，离散化可以简单地视为SSM前向传播中计算图的第一步。其他类型的SSM可以跳过离散化步骤，直接参数化\(\overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}})\，这可能更容易推理。

items.en: After the parameters have been transformed from \(\Delta, \bm{A}, \bm{B}, \bm{C}) \mapsto (\overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}}, \bm{C})\, the model can be computed in two ways, either as a linear recurrence (2) or a global convolution (3).
items.zh: 在参数从\(\Delta, \bm{A}, \bm{B}, \bm{C})\映射到\(\overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}}, \bm{C})\之后，模型可以通过两种方式计算：线性递推（2）或全局卷积（3）。

items.en: Commonly, the model uses the convolutional mode (3) for efficient parallelizable training (where the whole input sequence is seen ahead of time), and switched into recurrent mode (2) for efficient autoregressive inference (where the inputs are seen one timestep at a time).
items.zh: 通常，模型使用卷积模式（3）进行高效的并行训练（此时整个输入序列预先可见），并切换到循环模式（2）进行高效的自回归推理（此时输入每次一个时间步）。

items.en: An important property of equations (1) to (3) is that the model's dynamics are constant through time. In other words \(\\Delta,\\bm{A},\\bm{B},\\bm{C})\, and consequently \(\\overline{\\bm{A}},\\overline{\\bm{B}})\ as well, are fixed for all time-steps. This property is called linear time invariance (LTI), which is deeply connected to recurrence and convolutions. Informally, we think of LTI SSMs as being equivalent to any linear recurrence (2a) or convolution (3b), and use LTI as an umbrella term for these classes of models.
items.zh: 方程(1)到(3)的一个重要特性是模型的动态随时间保持恒定。换句话说，\(\\Delta,\\bm{A},\\bm{B},\\bm{C})\ 以及因此的 \(\\overline{\\bm{A}},\\overline{\\bm{B}})\ 在所有时间步上都是固定的。这个性质称为线性时不变性（LTI），它与循环和卷积密切相关。非正式地，我们认为LTI SSM等价于任何线性循环（2a）或卷积（3b），并用LTI作为这类模型的统称。

items.en: Thus far, all structured SSMs have been LTI (e.g. computed as convolutions) because of fundamental efficiency constraints, discussed in Section 3.3. However, a core insight of this work is that LTI models have fundamental limitations in modeling certain types of data, and our technical contributions involve removing the LTI constraint while overcoming the efficiency bottlenecks.
items.zh: 到目前为止，所有结构化SSM都是LTI（例如作为卷积计算），这是由于基本效率约束，这将在第3.3节讨论。然而，本文的一个核心见解是LTI模型在建模某些类型的数据时存在根本限制，我们的技术贡献涉及在克服效率瓶颈的同时移除LTI约束。

items.en: Finally, we note that structured SSMs are so named because computing them efficiently also requires imposing structure on the \(\\bm{A}\) matrix. The most popular form of structure is diagonal, which we also use.
items.zh: 最后，我们注意到结构化SSM之所以得名，是因为高效计算它们还需要对\(\\bm{A}\)矩阵施加结构。最流行的结构形式是对角矩阵，我们也将使用它。

items.en: In this case, the \(\\bm{A}\in\\mathbb{R}^{N\\times N},\\bm{B}\in\\mathbb{R}^{N\\times 1},\\bm{C}\in\\mathbb{R}^{1\\times N}\) matrices can all be represented by \(N\) numbers. To operate over an input sequence \(x\) of batch size \(B\) and length \(L\) with \(D\) channels, the SSM is applied independently to each channel. Note that in this case, the total hidden state has dimension \(DN\) per input, and computing it over the sequence length requires \(O(BLDN)\) time and memory; this is the root of the fundamental efficiency bottleneck addressed in Section 3.3.
items.zh: 在这种情况下，\(\\bm{A}\in\\mathbb{R}^{N\\times N},\\bm{B}\in\\mathbb{R}^{N\\times 1},\\bm{C}\in\\mathbb{R}^{1\\times N}\)矩阵都可以用N个数表示。为了处理一个批量大小为B、长度为L、具有D个通道的输入序列x，SSM独立应用于每个通道。注意，在这种情况下，每个输入的总隐藏状态维度为\(DN\)，在整个序列长度上计算它需要\(O(BLDN)\)的时间和内存；这是第3.3节所述基本效率瓶颈的根源。

items.en: We note that the term state space model has a very broad meaning which simply represents the notion of any recurrent process with a latent state. It has been used to refer to many disparate concepts in different disciplines, including Markov decision processes (MDP) (reinforcement learning), dynamic causal modeling (DCM) (computational neuroscience), Kalman filters (controls), hidden Markov models (HMM) and linear dynamical systems (LDS) (machine learning), and recurrent (and sometimes convolutional) models at large (deep learning).
items.zh: 我们注意到，状态空间模型一词含义非常广泛，它泛指任何具有隐状态的递归过程。该术语在不同学科中被用于指代许多不同的概念，包括马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）（强化学习）、动态因果建模（DCM）（计算神经科学）、卡尔曼滤波器（控制论）、隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）和线性动力系统（LDS）（机器学习），以及广义上的递归（有时是卷积）模型（深度学习）。

items.en: Throughout this entire paper we use the term “SSM” to refer exclusively to the class of structured SSMs or S4 models and use these terms interchangeably. For convenience we may also include derivatives of such models, such as those focusing on either the linear-recurrence or global-convolution viewpoints, and clarify nuances when necessary.
items.zh: 在本文中，术语“SSM”特指结构化SSM或S4模型，这两个术语可互换使用。为方便起见，我们可能也会包含此类模型的衍生物，例如专注于线性递归或全局卷积视角的模型，并在必要时澄清细微差别。

items.en: SSMs are standalone sequence transformations that can be incorporated into end-to-end neural network architectures. (We also sometimes call SSM architectures SSNNs, which are to SSM layers as CNNs are to linear convolution layers.) We discuss some of the most well-known SSM architectures, many of which will also serve as our primary baselines.
items.zh: SSM是独立的序列变换，可以集成到端到端神经网络架构中。（我们有时也将SSM架构称为SSNN，SSNN之于SSM层，正如CNN之于线性卷积层。）我们讨论了一些最著名的SSM架构，其中许多也将作为我们的主要基线模型。

items.en: Linear attention is an approximation of self-attention involving a recurrence which can be viewed as a degenerate linear SSM.
items.zh: 线性注意力机制是自注意力的一种近似，其涉及一个递归，可视为退化的线性SSM。

items.en: H3 generalized this recurrence to use S4; it can be viewed as an architecture with an SSM sandwiched by two gated connections (Figure 3). H3 also inserts a standard local convolution, which they frame as a shift-SSM, before the main SSM layer.
items.zh: H3将这一递归推广到使用S4；它可以看作一个架构，其中SSM夹在两个门控连接之间（图3）。H3还在主SSM层之前插入了一个标准局部卷积，他们将其称为shift-SSM。

items.en: Hyena uses the same architecture as H3 but replaces the S4 layer with an MLP-parameterized global convolution.
items.zh: Hyena采用了与H3相同的架构，但用MLP参数化的全局卷积替代了S4层。

items.en: RetNet adds an additional gate to the architecture and uses a simpler SSM, allowing an alternative parallelizable computation path, using a variant of multi-head attention (MHA) instead of convolutions.
items.zh: RetNet在架构中增加了一个额外的门，并使用更简单的SSM，从而允许另一种可并行的计算路径，使用多头注意力机制（MHA）的变体代替卷积。

items.en: RWKV is a recent RNN designed for language modeling based on another linear attention approximation, the attention-free Transformer. Its main "WKV" mechanism involves LTI recurrences and can be viewed as the ratio of two SSMs.
items.zh: RWKV是一种最近提出的基于另一种线性注意力近似的RNN，用于语言建模，即无注意力Transformer。其主要“WKV”机制涉及LTI循环，可以看作是两种SSM的比率。

items.en: Other closely related SSMs and architectures are discussed further in an extended related work (LABEL:sec:related). We highlight in particular S5, QRNN, and SRU, which we view as the most closely related methods to our core selective SSM.
items.zh: 其他密切相关的SSM和架构在扩展相关工作（LABEL:sec:related）中进一步讨论。我们特别强调S5、QRNN和SRU，它们被视为与我们核心选择性SSM最相关的方法。

items.en: We motivate our selection mechanism using intuition from synthetic tasks (Section 3.1), then explain how to incorporate this mechanism into state space models (Section 3.2). The resulting time-varying SSMs cannot use convolutions, presenting a technical challenge of how to compute them efficiently. We overcome this with a hardware-aware algorithm that exploits the memory hierarchy on modern hardware (Section 3.3). We then describe a simple SSM architecture without attention or even MLP blocks (Section 3.4). Finally, we discuss some additional properties of selection mechanisms (Section 3.5).
items.zh: 我们使用来自合成任务的直觉来激发我们的选择机制（第3.1节），然后解释如何将这一机制融入状态空间模型（第3.2节）。由此得到的时变SSM无法使用卷积，这提出了如何高效计算它们的技术挑战。我们通过一种硬件感知算法克服了这一挑战，该算法利用了现代硬件上的内存层次结构（第3.3节）。然后，我们描述了一种不含注意力机制甚至MLP块的简单SSM架构（第3.4节）。最后，我们讨论了选择机制的一些额外性质（第3.5节）。

full.sec: 3.1 Motivation: Selection as a Means of Compression
full.secZh: 3.1 动机：作为一种压缩手段的选择

items.en: We argue that a fundamental problem of sequence modeling is compressing context into a smaller state. In fact, we can view the tradeoffs of popular sequence models from this point of view. For example, attention is both effective and inefficient because it explicitly does not compress context at all. This can be seen from the fact that autoregressive inference requires explicitly storing the entire context (i.e. the KV cache), which directly causes the slow linear-time inference and quadratic-time training of Transformers. On the other hand, recurrent models are efficient because they have a finite state, implying constant-time inference and linear-time training. However, their effectiveness is limited by how well this state has compressed the context.
items.zh: 我们主张，序列建模的一个根本问题是将上下文压缩成一个更小的状态。事实上，我们可以从这个角度审视流行序列模型的权衡。例如，注意力机制既有效又低效，因为它明确地不压缩任何上下文。这可以从自回归推理需要显式存储整个上下文（即KV缓存）这一事实看出，这直接导致了Transformer缓慢的线性时间推理和二次时间训练。另一方面，循环模型高效是因为它们具有有限状态，意味着常数时间推理和线性时间训练。然而，它们的有效性受限于状态对上下文的压缩程度。

items.en: To understand this principle, we focus on two running examples of synthetic tasks (Figure˜2).
items.zh: 为了理解这一原理，我们聚焦于两个合成任务的运行示例（图˜2）。

items.en: The Selective Copying task modifies the popular Copying task by varying the position of the tokens to memorize. It requires content-aware reasoning to be able to memorize the relevant tokens (colored) and filter out the irrelevant ones (white).
items.zh: 选择性复制任务通过改变需要记忆的标记位置来修改流行的复制任务。它需要内容感知推理，以便记住相关标记（彩色）并过滤掉无关标记（白色）。

items.en: The Induction Heads task is a well-known mechanism hypothesized to explain the majority of in-context learning abilities of LLMs. It requires context-aware reasoning to know when to produce the correct output in the appropriate context (black).
items.zh: 归纳头任务是一种众所周知的机制，被假设用于解释LLM的大部分上下文学习能力。它需要上下文感知推理，以便知道何时在适当上下文中生成正确的输出（黑色）。

items.en: These tasks reveal the failure mode of LTI models. From the recurrent view, their constant dynamics (e.g. the \( \overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}} )\ transitions in (2)) cannot let them select the correct information from their context, or affect the hidden state passed along the sequence in an input-dependent way. From the convolutional view, it is known that global convolutions can solve the vanilla Copying task because it only requires time-awareness, but that they have difficulty with the Selective Copying task because of lack of content-awareness (Figure˜2). More concretely, the spacing between inputs-to-outputs is varying and cannot be modeled by static convolution kernels.
items.zh: 这些任务揭示了LTI模型的失败模式。从循环视角看，它们的恒定动态（例如(2)中的\(\overline{\bm{A}},\overline{\bm{B}}\)变换）无法让它们从上下文中选择正确的信息，也无法以输入相关的方式影响沿序列传递的隐藏状态。从卷积视角看，已知全局卷积可以解决原始的复制任务，因为它只需要时间感知，但它们在选择性复制任务上存在困难，因为缺乏内容感知（图˜2）。更具体地说，输入到输出之间的间距是变化的，无法由静态卷积核建模。

items.en: In summary, the efficiency vs. effectiveness tradeoff of sequence models is characterized by how well they compress their state: efficient models must have a small state, while effective models must have a state that contains all necessary information from the context. In turn, we propose that a fundamental principle for building sequence models is selectivity: or the context-aware ability to focus on or filter out inputs into a sequential state. In particular, a selection mechanism controls how information propagates or interacts along the sequence dimension (see Section~3.5 for more discussion).
items.zh: 总之，序列模型的效率与有效性权衡取决于其对状态的压缩程度：高效模型必须拥有小状态，而有效模型的状态必须包含上下文中的所有必要信息。相应地，我们提出构建序列模型的一个基本原则是选择性：即能够根据上下文关注或过滤输入到序列状态中的能力。特别地，选择机制控制信息沿序列维度传播或交互的方式（更多讨论见第~3.5节）。

items.capEn: Figure 2: (Left) The standard version of the Copying task involves constant spacing between input and output elements and is easily solved by time-invariant models such as linear recurrences and global convolutions. (Right Top) The Selective Copying task has random spacing in between inputs and requ

items.en: One method of incorporating a selection mechanism into models is by letting their parameters that affect interactions along the sequence (e.g. the recurrent dynamics of an RNN or the convolution kernel of a CNN) be input-dependent.
items.zh: 将选择机制纳入模型的一种方法是让影响序列交互的参数（例如RNN的循环动态或CNN的卷积核）依赖于输入。

items.en: Algorithms˜1 and 2 illustrates the main selection mechanism that we use. The main difference is simply making several parameters \(\Delta, \bm{B}, \bm{C}\) functions of the input, along with the associated changes to tensor shapes throughout. In particular, we highlight that these parameters now have a length dimension \(L\), meaning that the model has changed from time-invariant to time-varying. (Note that shape annotations were described in Section˜2.) This loses the equivalence to convolutions (3) with implications for its efficiency, discussed next.
items.zh: 算法1和2说明我们所使用的主要选择机制。主要区别只是让几个参数\(\Delta, \bm{B}, \bm{C}\)成为输入的函数，同时伴随整个张量形状的相关变化。特别地，我们强调这些参数现在具有长度维度\(L\)，这意味着模型从时不变变为时变。（注意，形状注释已在第2节中描述。）这失去了与卷积（3）的等价性，对其效率产生影响，将在后面讨论。

items.en: We specifically choose \(s_{B}(x)=\mathsf{Linear}_{N}(x)\), \(s_{C}(x)=\mathsf{Linear}_{N}(x)\), \(s_{\Delta}(x)=\mathsf{Broadcast}_{D}(\mathsf{Linear}_{1}(x))\), and \(\tau_{\Delta}=\mathsf{softplus}\), where \(\mathsf{Linear}_{d}\) is a parameterized projection to dimension \(d\). The choice of \(s_{\Delta}\) and \(\tau_{\Delta}\) is due to a connection to RNN gating mechanisms explained in Section˜3.5.
items.zh: 我们具体选择\(s_{B}(x)=\mathsf{Linear}_{N}(x)\)、\(s_{C}(x)=\mathsf{Linear}_{N}(x)\)、\(s_{\Delta}(x)=\mathsf{Broadcast}_{D}(\mathsf{Linear}_{1}(x))\)和\(\tau_{\Delta}=\mathsf{softplus}\)，其中\(\mathsf{Linear}_{d}\)是到维度\(d\)的参数化投影。选择\(s_{\Delta}\)和\(\tau_{\Delta}\)是由于与第3.5节中解释的RNN门控机制有关。

items.en: Hardware-friendly primitives such as convolutions and attention enjoy widespread application. Here we aim to make selective SSMs efficient on modern hardware (GPUs) as well. The selection mechanism is quite natural, and earlier works attempted to incorporate special cases of selection, such as letting \(\Delta\) vary over time in recurrent SSMs. However, as previously mentioned a core limitation in the usage of SSMs is their computational efficiency, which was why S4 and all derivatives used LTI (non-selective) models, most commonly in the form of global convolutions.
items.zh: 硬件友好的基元（如卷积和注意力机制）得到了广泛应用。在这里，我们旨在使选择性SSM在现代硬件（GPU）上也变得高效。选择机制相当自然，早期的工作尝试纳入选择的特殊情况，例如让\(\Delta\)在循环SSM中随时间变化。然而，如前所述，SSM使用的一个核心限制是它们的计算效率，这就是为什么S4及其所有衍生模型使用LTI（非选择性）模型，通常以全局卷积的形式。

items.en: We first revisit this motivation and overview our approach to overcome limitations of prior methods.
items.zh: 我们首先重新审视这一动机，并概述我们克服先前方法局限性的方法。

items.en: At a high level, recurrent models such as SSMs always balance a tradeoff between expressivity and speed: as discussed in Section~3.1, models with larger hidden state dimension should be more effective but slower. Thus we want to maximize hidden state dimension without paying speed and memory costs.
items.zh: 在较高层面上，递归模型（如SSM）总是在表现力和速度之间权衡：如第3.1节所述，具有更大隐藏状态维度的模型应该更有效但更慢。因此，我们希望在不付出速度和内存代价的情况下最大化隐藏状态维度。

items.en: Note that the recurrent mode is more flexible than the convolution mode, since the latter (3) is derived from expanding the former (2). However, this would require computing and materializing the latent state \(h\) with shape \(\mathtt{(B,L,D,N)}\), which is much larger (by a factor of \(N\), the SSM state dimension) than the input \(x\) and output \(y\) of shape \(\mathtt{(B,L,D)}\). Thus the more efficient convolution mode was introduced which could bypass the state computation and materializes a convolution kernel (3a) of size only \(\mathtt{(B,L,D)}\).
items.zh: 注意，递归模式比卷积模式更灵活，因为后者（3）是从前者（2）展开推导而来的。然而，这将需要计算并实现形状为\(\mathtt{(B,L,D,N)}\)的潜在状态\(h\)，它比形状为\(\mathtt{(B,L,D)}\)的输入\(x\)和输出\(y\)大得多（大\(N\)倍，\(N\)是SSM状态维度）。因此，引入了更高效的卷积模式，它可以绕过状态计算，仅实现大小为\(\mathtt{(B,L,D)}\)的卷积核(3a)。

items.en: Prior LTI state space models leverage the dual recurrent-convolutional forms to increase the effective state dimension by a factor of \(N\) (\(\approx 10-100\)), much larger than traditional RNNs, without efficiency penalties.
items.zh: 先前的LTI状态空间模型利用递归-卷积的双重形式将有效状态维度增加了\(N\)倍（约10-100倍），远大于传统RNN，且没有效率损失。

full.sec: 3.3.2 Overview of Selective Scan: Hardware-Aware State Expansion
full.secZh: 3.3.2 选择性扫描概述：硬件感知状态扩展

items.en: The selection mechanism is designed to overcome the limitations of LTI models; at the same time, we therefore need to revisit the computation problem of SSMs. We address this with three classical techniques: kernel fusion, parallel scan, and recomputation. We make two main observations:
items.zh: 选择机制旨在克服LTI模型的局限性；同时，我们因此需要重新审视SSM的计算问题。我们通过三种经典技术来解决这一问题：核融合、并行扫描和重计算。我们有两个主要观察：

items.en: The naive recurrent computation uses \(O(BLDN)\) FLOPs while the convolutional computation uses \(O(BLD\log(L))\) FLOPs, and the former has a lower constant factor. Thus for long sequences and not-too-large state dimension \(N\), the recurrent mode can actually use fewer FLOPs.
items.zh: 朴素的循环计算使用\(O(BLDN)\) FLOPs，而卷积计算使用\(O(BLD\log(L))\) FLOPs，且前者的常数因子更低。因此，对于长序列和不太大的状态维度\(N\)，循环模式实际上可以使用更少的FLOPs。

items.en: The two challenges are the sequential nature of recurrence, and the large memory usage. To address the latter, just like the convolutional mode, we can attempt to not actually materialize the full state \(h\).
items.zh: 两个挑战是循环的顺序性质和大内存使用。为了解决后者，就像卷积模式一样，我们可以尝试不实际物化完整的状态\(h\)。

items.en: The main idea is to leverage properties of modern accelerators (GPUs) to materialize the state \(h\) only in more efficient levels of the memory hierarchy. In particular, most operations (except matrix multiplication) are bounded by memory bandwidth. This includes our scan operation, and we use kernel fusion to reduce the amount of memory IOs, leading to a significant speedup compared to a standard implementation.
items.zh: 主要思想是利用现代加速器（GPU）的特性，仅在内存层次结构中更高效的级别上物化状态\(h\)。特别是，大多数操作（除了矩阵乘法）受限于内存带宽。这包括我们的扫描操作，我们使用核融合来减少内存输入输出量，从而与标准实现相比获得显著的加速。

items.en: Concretely, instead of preparing the scan input \(\overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}}\) of size \(\mathtt{(B,L,D,N)}\) in GPU HBM (high-bandwidth memory), we load the SSM parameters \(\Delta, \bm{A}, \bm{B}, \bm{C}\) directly from slow HBM to fast SRAM, perform the discretization and recurrence in SRAM, and then write the final outputs of size \(\mathtt{B,L,D}\) back to HBM.
items.zh: 具体来说，我们不是在GPU的HBM（高带宽内存）中准备大小为\(\mathtt{(B,L,D,N)}\)的扫描输入\(\overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}}\)，而是将SSM参数\(\Delta, \bm{A}, \bm{B}, \bm{C}\)直接从慢速HBM加载到快速SRAM，在SRAM中执行离散化和循环，然后将大小为\(\mathtt{B,L,D}\)的最终输出写回HBM。

items.en: To avoid the sequential recurrence, we observe that despite not being linear it can still be parallelized with a work-efficient parallel scan algorithm.
items.zh: 为了避免顺序循环，我们观察到，尽管不是线性的，它仍然可以通过一种工作高效的并行扫描算法进行并行化。

items.en: Finally, we must also avoid saving the intermediate states, which are necessary for backpropagation. We carefully apply the classic technique of recomputation to reduce the memory requirements: the intermediate states are not stored but recomputed in the backward pass when the inputs are loaded from HBM to SRAM. As a result, the fused selective scan layer has the same memory requirements as an optimized transformer implementation with FlashAttention.
items.zh: 最后，我们还必须避免保存中间状态，这些状态是反向传播所必需的。我们仔细应用了经典的重计算技术来减少内存需求：中间状态不被存储，而是在反向传播过程中当输入从HBM加载到SRAM时重新计算。因此，融合的选择性扫描层具有与优化后的Transformer实现（使用FlashAttention）相同的内存需求。

items.en: Details of the fused kernel and recomputation are in LABEL:sec:hardware_aware_algo. The full Selective SSM layer and algorithm is illustrated in Figure 1.
items.zh: 融合内核和重计算的细节在LABEL:sec:hardware_aware_algo中。完整的Selective SSM层和算法如图1所示。

items.en: As with structured SSMs, selective SSMs are standalone sequence transformations that can be flexibly incorporated into neural networks. The H3 architecture is the basis for the most well-known SSM architectures (Section 2), which are generally comprised of a block inspired by linear attention interleaved with an MLP (multi-layer perceptron) block. We simplify this architecture by combining these two components into one, which is stacked homogeneously (Figure 3). This is inspired by the gated attention unit (GAU), which did something similar for attention.
items.zh: 与结构化SSM一样，选择性SSM是独立的序列变换，可以灵活地集成到神经网络中。H3架构是最著名的SSM架构（第2节）的基础，这些架构通常由受线性注意力启发的块与MLP（多层感知机）块交错组成。我们通过将这两个组件合并为一个来简化此架构，并以同质方式堆叠（图3）。这受到了门控注意力单元（GAU）的启发，该单元对注意力做了类似的事情。

items.en: This architecture involves expanding the model dimension \(D\) by a controllable expansion factor \(E\). For each block, most of the parameters (\(3ED^{2}\)) are in the linear projections (\(2ED^{2}\) for input projections, \(ED^{2}\) for output projection) while the inner SSM contributes less. The number of SSM parameters (projections for \(\Delta,\bm{B},\bm{C}\), and the matrix \(\bm{A}\)) are much smaller in comparison. We repeat this block, interleaved with standard normalization and residual connections, to form the Mamba architecture. We always fix to \(E=2\) in our experiments and use two stacks of the block to match the \(12D^{2}\) parameters of a Transformer’s interleaved MHA (multi-head attention) and MLP blocks. We use the SiLU / Swish activation function, motivated so that the Gated MLP becomes the popular “SwiGLU” variant. Finally, we additionally use an optional normalization layer (we choose LayerNorm), motivated by RetNet’s usage of a normalization layer in a similar location.
items.zh: 该架构通过可控扩展因子\(E\)扩增模型维度\(D\)。对于每个块，大部分参数（\(3ED^{2}\)）位于线性投影中（输入投影\(2ED^{2}\)，输出投影\(ED^{2}\)），而内部SSM贡献较少。相比之下，SSM参数的数目（\(\Delta,\bm{B},\bm{C}\)的投影及矩阵\(\bm{A}\)）要小得多。我们重复该块，与标准归一化和残差连接交错，形成Mamba架构。在实验中，我们始终固定\(E=2\)，并使用两个堆叠的块来匹配Transformer中交错MHA（多头注意力）和MLP块的\(12D^{2}\)个参数。我们使用SiLU/Swish激活函数，目的是使门控MLP成为流行的“SwiGLU”变体。最后，我们额外使用一个可选的归一化层（我们选择LayerNorm），这是受RetNet在类似位置使用归一化层的启发。

items.en: The selection mechanism is a broader concept that can be applied in different ways, such as to more traditional RNNs or CNNs, to different parameters (e.g., \(\bm{A}\) in Algorithm 2), or using different transformations \(s(x)\).
items.zh: 选择机制是一个更广泛的概念，可以以不同的方式应用，例如应用于更传统的RNN或CNN，应用于不同的参数（例如算法2中的\(\bm{A}\)），或者使用不同的变换\(s(x)\)。

items.en: We highlight the most important connection: the classical gating mechanism of RNNs is an instance of our selection mechanism for SSMs. We note that the connection between RNN gating and the discretization of continuous-time systems is well established. In fact, Theorem 1 is an improvement of generalizing to the ZOH discretization and input-dependent gates (proof in LABEL:sec:mechanics). More broadly, \(\Delta\) in SSMs can be seen to play a generalized role of the RNN gating mechanism. In line with prior work, we adopt the view that discretization of SSMs is the principled foundation of heuristic gating mechanisms.
items.zh: 我们强调最重要的联系：RNN的经典门控机制是我们SSM选择机制的一个实例。我们注意到，RNN门控与连续时间系统离散化之间的联系已得到充分确立。事实上，定理1是对推广到ZOH离散化和输入相关门的一个改进（证明见第LABEL:sec:mechanics节）。更广泛地说，SSM中的\(\Delta\)可以被视为RNN门控机制的广义角色。与先前工作一致，我们采用SSM离散化是启发式门控机制原则基础的看法。

In particular, note that if a given input \(x_{t}\) should be completely ignored (as necessary in the synthetic tasks), all \(D\) channels should ignore it, and so we project the input down to \(1\) dimension before repeating/broadcasting with \(\Delta\).
items.zh: 如第3.2节所述，我们对\(s_{\Delta}, \tau_{\Delta}\)的具体选择源于这一联系。特别地，注意如果给定输入\(x_{t}\)应被完全忽略（如在合成任务中所需），所有\(D\)个通道都应忽略它，因此我们先将输入投影到\(1\)维，然后与\(\Delta\)重复/广播。

items.en: We elaborate on three particular mechanistic effects of selection.
items.zh: 我们详细阐述了选择的三种特定机制效应。

items.en: Selectivity allows filtering out irrelevant noise tokens that may occur between inputs of interest. This is exemplified by the Selective Copying task, but occurs ubiquitously in common data modalities, particularly for discrete data – for example the presence of language fillers such as "um". This property arises because the model can mechanistically filter out any particular input \(x_{t}\), for example in the gated RNN case (Theorem 1) when \(g_{t}\to 0\).
items.zh: 选择性允许过滤掉可能出现在感兴趣输入之间的无关噪声词元。这一点在选择性复制任务中得到了例证，但在常见数据模态中普遍存在，尤其是对于离散数据——例如"嗯"这样的语言填充词。该属性之所以出现，是因为模型可以从机制上过滤掉任何特定输入 \(x_{t}\)，例如在门控RNN情况（定理1）中当 \(g_{t}\to 0\)。

items.en: It has been empirically observed that many sequence models do not improve with longer context, despite the principle that more context should lead to strictly better performance. An explanation is that many sequence models cannot effectively ignore irrelevant context when necessary; an intuitive example are global convolutions (and general LTI models). On the other hand, selective models can simply reset their state at any time to remove extraneous history, and thus their performance in principle improves monotonically with context length (e.g. Section 4.3.2).
items.zh: 经验观察发现，许多序列模型并不会随着上下文变长而改善，尽管原则上更多的上下文应导致更严格的性能提升。一个解释是，许多序列模型在必要时无法有效忽略无关上下文；一个直观的例子是全局卷积（以及一般的LTI模型）。另一方面，选择性模型可以随时重置其状态以移除无关历史，因此原则上其性能随上下文长度单调提升（例如第4.3.2节）。

items.en: In settings where multiple independent sequences are stitched together, Transformers can keep them separate by instantiating a particular attention mask, while LTI models will bleed information between the sequences. Selective SSMs can also reset their state at boundaries (e.g. \(\Delta_{t}\to \infty\), or Theorem 1 when \(g_{t}\to 1\)). These settings may occur artificially (e.g. packing documents together to improve hardware utilization) or naturally (e.g. episode boundaries in reinforcement learning).
items.zh: 在多个独立序列拼接在一起的设置中，Transformer可以通过实例化特定的注意力掩码来将它们分开，而LTI模型则会在序列之间泄漏信息。选择性SSM也可以在边界处重置其状态（例如 \(\Delta_{t}\to \infty\) 或定理1中当 \(g_{t}\to 1\)）。这些设置可能人为出现（例如将文档打包在一起以提高硬件利用率）或自然出现（例如强化学习中的回合边界）。

items.en: Additionally, we elaborate on effects of each selective parameter.
items.zh: 此外，我们详细阐述了每个选择性参数的影响。

items.en: In general, \(\Delta\) controls the balance between how much to focus or ignore the current input \(x_{t}\). It generalizes RNN gates (e.g. \(g_{t}\) in Theorem~1): mechanically, a large \(\Delta\) resets the state \(h\) and focuses on the current input \(x\), while a small \(\Delta\) persists the state and ignores the current input. SSMs (1)-(2) can be interpreted as a continuous system discretized by a timestep \(\Delta\), and in this context the intuition is that large \(\Delta\ \to\ \infty\) represents the system focusing on the current input for longer (thus “selecting” it and forgetting its current state) while a small \(\Delta\ \to\ 0\) represents a transient input that is ignored.
items.zh: 一般来说，\(\Delta\) 控制着模型关注或忽略当前输入 \(x_{t}\) 的程度。它推广了RNN门控（例如定理1中的 \(g_{t}\)）：从机械角度看，大的 \(\Delta\) 会重置状态 \(h\) 并专注于当前输入 \(x\)，而小的 \(\Delta\) 则保持状态并忽略当前输入。SSM (1)-(2) 可以解释为由时间步长 \(\Delta\) 离散化的连续系统，在这种上下文中，直觉是大的 \(\Delta\ \to\ \infty\) 表示系统更长时间地专注于当前输入（从而“选择”它并忘记当前状态），而小的 \(\Delta\ \to\ 0\) 表示被忽略的瞬态输入。

items.en: We remark that while the \(\bm{A}\) parameter could also be selective, it ultimately affects the model only through its interaction with \(\Delta\) via \(\overline{\bm{A}} = \exp(\Delta \bm{A})\) (the discretization (4)). Thus selectivity in \(\Delta\) is enough to ensure selectivity in \((\overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}})\), and is the main source of improvement. We hypothesize that making \(\bm{A}\) selective in addition to (or instead of) \(\Delta\) would have similar performance, and leave it out for simplicity.
items.zh: 我们注意到，虽然 \(\bm{A}\) 参数也可以具有选择性，但它最终仅通过 \(\overline{\bm{A}} = \exp(\Delta \bm{A})\)（离散化公式 (4)）与 \(\Delta\) 的相互作用来影响模型。因此，\(\Delta\) 的选择性足以确保 \((\overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}})\) 的选择性，并且是改进的主要来源。我们假设，使 \(\bm{A}\) 在 \(\Delta\) 之外（或代替 \(\Delta\)）也具有选择性，将获得类似的性能，但为了简单起见，我们将其排除在外。

items.en: As discussed in Section~3.1, the most important property of selectivity is filtering out irrelevant information so that a sequence model’s context can be compressed into an efficient state. In an SSM, modifying \(\bm{B}\) and \(\bm{C}\) to be selective allows finer-grained control over whether to let an input \(x_{t}\) into the state \(h_{t}\), or the state into the output \(y_{t}\). These can be interpreted as allowing the model to modulate the recurrent dynamics based on content (input) and context (hidden states) respectively.
items.zh: 如第3.1节所述，选择性最重要的属性是过滤掉不相关的信息，以便序列模型的上下文可以压缩成高效的状态。在SSM中，将 \(\bm{B}\) 和 \(\bm{C}\) 修改为具有选择性，可以更精细地控制是否让输入 \(x_{t}\) 进入状态 \(h_{t}\)，或让状态进入输出 \(y_{t}\)。这可以解释为允许模型分别基于内容（输入）和上下文（隐藏状态）来调节循环动态。

items.en: Most prior SSMs use complex numbers in their state \(h\), which is necessary for strong performance on many tasks in perceptual modalities. However, it has been empirically observed that completely real-valued SSMs seem to work fine, and possibly even better, in some settings. We use real values as the default, which work well for all but one of our tasks; we hypothesize that the complex-real tradeoff is related to the continuous-discrete spectrum in data modalities, where complex numbers are helpful for continuous modalities (e.g. audio, video) but not discrete (e.g. text, DNA).
items.zh: 大多数先前的 SSM 在其状态 \(h\) 中使用复数，这对于在感知模态的许多任务上取得强性能是必要的。然而，经验观察表明，完全实值的 SSM 在某些设置下似乎工作良好，甚至可能更好。我们默认使用实值，这在我们除一个任务外的所有任务上都表现良好；我们假设复数-实数的权衡与数据模态中的连续-离散谱有关，其中复数有助于连续模态（如音频、视频），但对离散模态（如文本、DNA）无益。

items.en: Most prior SSMs also suggest special initializations, particularly in the complex-valued case, which can help in several settings such as low-data regimes. Our default initialization for the complex case is S4D-Lin and for the real case is S4D-Real, which is based on the HIPPO theory. These define the \(n\)-th element of \(\bm{A}\) as \(-1/2+ni\) and \(-(n+1)\) respectively. However, we expect many initializations to work fine, particularly in the large-data and real-valued SSM regimes; some ablations are considered in Section˜4.6.
items.zh: 大多数先前的 SSM 还建议特殊的初始化，尤其是在复数情况下，这可以在低数据场景等设置中有所帮助。我们对复数情况的默认初始化为 S4D-Lin，对实数情况为 S4D-Real，两者均基于 HIPPO 理论。这些将 \(\bm{A}\) 的第 \(n\) 个元素分别定义为 \(-1/2+ni\) 和 \(-(n+1)\)。然而，我们期望许多初始化都能工作良好，特别是在大数据和实值 SSM 场景中；第 4.6 节考虑了部分消融实验。

items.en: We defined the selective adjustment to \(\Delta\) as \(s_{\Delta}(x)=\mathsf{Broadcast}_{D}(\mathsf{Linear}_{1}(x))\), which was motivated by the mechanics of \(\Delta\) (Section˜3.5). We observe that it can be generalized from dimension \(1\) to a larger dimension \(\mathtt{R}\). We set this to be a small fraction of \(\mathtt{D}\), which uses a negligible number of parameters compared to the main Linear projections in the block. We additionally note that the broadcasting operation can instead be viewed as another Linear projection, initialized to a specific pattern of \(1\)'s and \(0\)'s; if this projection is trainable, this leads to the alternative \(s_{\Delta}(x)=\mathsf{Linear}_{D}(\mathsf{Linear}_{R}(x))\), which can be viewed as a low-rank projection.
items.zh: 我们将对 \(\Delta\) 的选择性调整定义为 \(s_{\Delta}(x)=\mathsf{Broadcast}_{D}(\mathsf{Linear}_{1}(x))\)，这是受 \(\Delta\) 的机制（第 3.5 节）启发。我们观察到它可以从维度 \(1\) 推广到更大的维度 \(\mathtt{R}\)。我们将其设置为 \(\mathtt{D}\) 的一小部分，与块中的主线性投影相比，使用的参数数量可忽略不计。我们还注意到，广播操作可以视为另一个线性投影，初始化为特定的 \(1\) 和 \(0\) 模式；如果该投影是可训练的，则会产生替代方案 \(s_{\Delta}(x)=\mathsf{Linear}_{D}(\mathsf{Linear}_{R}(x))\)，可视为一个低秩投影。

items.en: In our experiments, the \(\Delta\) parameter (which can be viewed as a bias term) is initialized to \(\tau_{\Delta}^{-1}(\mathsf{Uniform}([0.001,0.1]))\), following prior work on SSMs.
items.zh: 在我们的实验中，\(\Delta\) 参数（可视为偏置项）被初始化为 \(\tau_{\Delta}^{-1}(\mathsf{Uniform}([0.001,0.1]))\)，遵循先前的 SSM 工作。

items.en: For brevity in our experimental results, we sometimes abbreviate selective SSMs as S6 models, because they are S4 models with a selection mechanism and computed with a scan.
items.zh: 为了简洁起见，在我们的实验报告中，有时将选择性 SSM 缩写为 S6 模型，因为它们是带有选择机制并通过扫描计算的 S4 模型。

items.en: The Copying task is one of the most well-studied synthetic tasks for sequence modeling, originally designed to test the memorization abilities of recurrent models. As discussed in Section 3.1, LTI SSMs (linear recurrences and global convolutions) can easily solve this task by only keeping track of time instead of reasoning about the data; for example, by constructing a convolution kernel of exactly the right length (Figure 2). This was explicitly validated in earlier work on global convolutions. The Selective Copying task prevents this shortcut by randomizing the spacing between tokens. Note that this task has been introduced before as the Denoising task.
items.zh: 复制任务是最经典的序列建模合成任务之一，最初用于测试循环模型的记忆能力。如第 3.1 节所述，LTI SSM（线性递归和全局卷积）可以轻松解决此任务，因为只需跟踪时间而不是推理数据；例如，构造一个恰好合适长度的卷积核（图 2）。这在早期关于全局卷积的工作中得到了明确验证。选择性复制任务通过随机化词元之间的间距来防止这种捷径。注意，该任务之前被称为去噪任务。

items.en: Note that many previous works argue that adding architecture gating (multiplicative interactions) can endow models with “data-dependence” and solve related tasks. However, we find this explanation insufficient intuitively because such gating does not interact along the sequence axis, and cannot affect the spacing between tokens. In particular, architecture gating is not an instance of a selection mechanism (see Section on Selection Mechanism).
items.zh: 注意，许多先前的工作认为，添加架构门控（乘性交互）可以使模型具备“数据依赖性”并解决相关任务。然而，我们凭直觉认为这种解释不够充分，因为这种门控不沿序列轴交互，无法影响词元之间的间距。特别是，架构门控并非选择机制的一个实例（参见选择机制章节）。

items.en: Induction heads is a simple task from the mechanistic interpretability lens that is surprisingly predictive of the in-context learning ability of LLMs. It requires models to perform associative recall and copy: for example, if the model has seen a bigram such as “Harry Potter” in the sequence, then the next time “Harry” appears in the same sequence, the model should be able to predict “Potter” by copying from history.
items.zh: 归纳头是从机械可解释性视角出发的一个简单任务，却惊人地预测了LLM的上下文学习能力。它要求模型执行关联回忆和复制：例如，如果模型在序列中看到了像“Harry Potter”这样的二元词组，那么当同一序列中再次出现“Harry”时，模型应能从历史记录中复制并预测“Potter”。

items.en: We train a 2-layer model on the induction heads task at sequence length \(256\), with a vocab size of \(16\), which is comparable to prior work on this task but with longer sequences. We additionally investigate generalization and extrapolation abilities by evaluating on a range of sequence lengths from \(2^{6}=64\) up to \(2^{20}=1048576\) at test time.
items.zh: 我们在序列长度为\(256\)、词表大小为\(16\)的归纳头任务上训练了一个2层模型，这与先前工作相当但序列更长。我们还通过在测试时评估从\(2^{6}=64\)到\(2^{20}=1048576\)的序列长度范围，研究了泛化和外推能力。

items.en: Following established work on induction heads, we use 2 layer models, which allows attention to mechanistically solve the induction heads task. We test both multi-head attention (8 heads, with various positional encodings) and SSM variants. We use a model dimension \(D\) of \(64\) for Mamba and \(128\) for the other models.
items.zh: 遵循归纳头领域的既成工作，我们使用2层模型，这使得注意力机制能够机械地解决归纳头任务。我们测试了多头注意力（8个头，采用多种位置编码）和SSM变体。我们对Mamba使用模型维度\(D=64\)，对其他模型使用\(128\)。

items.en: Out of positional encoding variants for attention models, xPos (which was designed for length extrapolation) is slightly better than the others; also note that all attention models were only tested up to sequence length \(2^{14}=16384\) due to memory limitations. Out of other SSMs, H3 and Hyena are similar, contrary to the findings in .
items.zh: 在注意力模型的位置编码变体中，xPos（专为长度外推设计）略优于其他；还需注意，由于内存限制，所有注意力模型仅在序列长度达\(2^{14}=16384\)时进行了测试。在其他SSM中，H3和Hyena表现相似，与某些研究结果相反。

items.en: We evaluate the Mamba architecture on standard autoregressive language modeling against other architectures, on both pretraining metrics (perplexity) and zero-shot evaluations. We set the model sizes (depth and width) to mirror GPT3 specifications. We use the Pile dataset, and follow the training recipe described in . All training details are in LABEL:sec:exp-details:lm.
items.zh: 我们在标准的自回归语言建模任务上评估Mamba架构与其他架构的对比，包括预训练指标（困惑度）和零样本评估。我们将模型规模（深度和宽度）设置为与GPT3规范一致。我们使用Pile数据集，并遵循文献中描述的训练方案。所有训练细节参见LABEL:sec:exp-details:lm章节。

items.en: For baselines, we compare against the standard Transformer architecture (GPT-3 architecture), as well as the strongest Transformer recipe we know of (here referred to as Transformer++), based on the PaLM and LLaMA architectures (e.g., rotary embedding, SwiGLU MLP, RMSNorm instead of LayerNorm, no linear bias, and higher learning rates). We also compare against other recent subquadratic architectures (Figure 6). All model details are in LABEL:sec:exp-details:lm.
items.zh: 对于基线，我们与标准Transformer架构（GPT-3架构）以及我们所知的最强Transformer配方（此处称为Transformer++）进行比较，后者基于PaLM和LLaMA架构（例如旋转位置编码、SwiGLU MLP、用RMSNorm替代LayerNorm、无线性偏置以及更高的学习率）。我们还与其他最近提出的次二次架构（图6）进行了比较。所有模型细节均在LABEL:sec:exp-details:lm中给出。

items.en: Motivated by the success of large language models, there has been recent exploration into using the foundation model paradigm for genomics. DNA has been likened to language in that it consists of sequences of discrete tokens with a finite vocabulary. It is also known for requiring long-range dependencies to model. We investigate Mamba as a foundation model backbone for pretraining and fine-tuning in the same setting as recent works on long-sequence models for DNA. In particular, we focus on two explorations: scaling laws across model size and sequence length (Figure 7), and a difficult downstream synthetic classification task requiring long context (Figure 9).
items.zh: 受大语言模型成功的启发，近期有研究探索将基础模型范式用于基因组学。DNA 被比作语言，因为它由离散词元序列组成，且词表有限。同时，DNA 建模需要远距离依赖。我们以与近期 DNA 长序列模型相同的方式，研究了 Mamba 作为基础模型骨干进行预训练和微调。特别地，我们聚焦于两个探索：模型规模和序列长度的缩放定律（图 7），以及一个需要长上下文的困难下游合成分类任务（图 9）。

items.en: For pretraining, we largely follow a standard causal language modeling (next-token prediction) setup for the training and model details (see also Section LABEL:sec:exp-details:lm). For the dataset, we largely follow the setup of HyenaDNA, which uses the HG38 dataset for pretraining consisting of a single human genome with about 4.5 billion tokens (DNA base pairs) in the training split.
items.zh: 对于预训练，我们主要遵循标准因果语言建模（下一个词预测）设置，包括训练和模型细节（参见第 LABEL:sec:exp-details:lm 节）。在数据集方面，我们主要遵循 HyenaDNA 的设置，使用 HG38 数据集进行预训练，该数据集包含约 45 亿个词元（DNA 碱基对）的单个人类基因组训练集。

items.en: In this experiment, we investigate the scaling properties of genomics foundation models with various model backbones (Figure~7 Left).
items.zh: 在本实验中，我们研究了具有不同模型骨干（如图7左所示）的基因组基础模型的缩放性质。

items.en: To advantage the baselines, we train on a short sequence length of \(1024\); as shown in Section~4.3.2, we expect results to favor Mamba even more at longer sequence lengths. We fix a global batch size of \(1024\), for a total of \(2^{20} \approx 1M\) tokens per batch. Models were trained for \(10K\) gradient steps for a total of \(10B\) tokens.
items.zh: 为了有利于基线，我们使用短序列长度 \(1024\) 进行训练；如第4.3.2节所示，我们预期在更长的序列长度下，结果会更有利于Mamba。我们将全局批次大小固定为 \(1024\)，每批总计约 \(2^{20} \approx 1M\) 个token。模型训练了 \(10K\) 个梯度步，总计 \(10B\) 个token。

items.en: In the next DNA experiment, we investigate the scaling properties of models with respect to sequence length. We only compare the HyenaDNA and Mamba models, as quadratic attention becomes prohibitively expensive at longer sequence lengths. We pretrain models on sequence lengths \(2^{10}=1024\), \(2^{12}=4096\), \(2^{14}=16384\), \(2^{16}=65536\), \(2^{18}=262144\), \(2^{20}=1048576\). We fix a model size of 6 layers by width \(128\) (about 1.3M-1.4M parameters). Models were trained for \(20K\) gradient steps for a total of \(\approx 330B\) tokens. The longer sequence lengths used sequence length warmup similar to .
items.zh: 在下一个DNA实验中，我们研究了模型关于序列长度的缩放性质。我们仅比较HyenaDNA和Mamba模型，因为二次注意力机制在较长序列长度下变得过于昂贵。我们在序列长度\(2^{10}=1024\)、\(2^{12}=4096\)、\(2^{14}=16384\)、\(2^{16}=65536\)、\(2^{18}=262144\)、\(2^{20}=1048576\)上对模型进行预训练。我们固定模型大小为6层，宽度\(128\)（约1.3M-1.4M参数）。模型训练了\(20K\)个梯度步，总计约\(330B\)个token。较长的序列长度使用了类似于的序列长度预热。

items.en: We evaluate models on a downstream task of classifying between 5 different species by randomly sampling a contiguous segment of their DNA. This task is adapted from HyenaDNA, which used the species \(\{\texttt{human},\texttt{lemur},\texttt{mouse},\texttt{pig},\texttt{hippo}\}\). We modify the task to be significantly more challenging by classifying between the five great ape species \(\{\texttt{human},\texttt{chimpanzee},\texttt{gorilla},\texttt{orangutan},\texttt{bonobo}\}\), which are known to share 99% of their DNA.
items.zh: 我们在一个下游任务上评估模型，该任务通过随机采样DNA的连续片段来区分5个不同物种。该任务改编自HyenaDNA，其使用的物种为\(\{\texttt{human},\texttt{lemur},\texttt{mouse},\texttt{pig},\texttt{hippo}\}\)。我们对该任务进行了修改，使其更具挑战性：区分五种大型猿类物种\(\{\texttt{human},\texttt{chimpanzee},\texttt{gorilla},\texttt{orangutan},\texttt{bonobo}\}\)，这些物种已知共享99%的DNA。

items.en: We evaluate pretraining quality (autoregressive next-sample prediction) on YouTubeMix, a standard piano music dataset used by prior work consisting of \(4\) hours of solo piano music, sampled at a rate of 16000 Hz. Pretraining details largely follow the standard language modeling setup (Section˜4.2). Figure˜9 evaluates the effect of increasing training sequence lengths from \(2^{13}=8192\) to \(2^{20}\approx 10^{6}\), while keeping computation fixed. (There are some slight edge cases to the way the data is curated, which may lead to kinks in the scaling curves. For example, only minute-long clips were available so the maximum sequence length is actually bounded by \(60s\cdot 16000Hz=960000\).
items.zh: 我们在 YouTubeMix 上评估预训练质量（自回归下一个样本预测），这是一个先前工作使用的标准钢琴音乐数据集，包含 4 小时的独奏钢琴音乐，采样率为 16000 Hz。预训练细节大致遵循标准语言建模设置（第 4.2 节）。图 9 评估了在保持计算量固定的情况下，将训练序列长度从 \(2^{13}=8192\) 增加到 \(2^{20}\approx 10^6\) 的效果。（数据整理方式存在一些轻微边缘情况，可能导致缩放曲线出现扭结。例如，只有一分钟长的片段可用，因此最大序列长度实际上受限于 \(60 s\cdot 16000 Hz = 960000\)。）

items.en: Both Mamba and the SaShiMi (S4+MLP) baseline improve consistently with longer context lengths; Mamba is better throughout, and the gap widens at longer lengths. The main metric is bits per byte (BPB), which is a constant factor \(\log(2)\) of the standard negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss for pretraining other modalities.
items.zh: Mamba 和 SaShiMi（S4+MLP）基线都随着上下文长度的增加而持续改进；Mamba 始终更好，且在更长长度上差距扩大。主要指标是比特每字节（BPB），它是其他模态预训练的标准负对数似然（NLL）损失的一个常数因子 \(\log(2)\)。

items.en: We note one important detail: this is the only experiment in this paper in which we switched from the real parameterization to complex (Section˜3.6). We show additional ablations in LABEL:sec:exp-details:audio.
items.zh: 我们注意一个重要细节：这是本文中唯一从实参数化切换到复数参数化的实验（第 3.6 节）。我们在 LABEL:sec:exp-details:audio 中展示了额外的消融实验。

items.en: SC09 is a benchmark speech generation dataset, consisting of 1-second clips sampled at 16000 Hz of the digits 'zero' through 'nine' with highly variable characteristics. We largely follow the autoregressive training setup and generation protocol of .
items.zh: SC09是一个基准语音生成数据集，包含从“零”到“九”的数字，采样率为16000 Hz的1秒片段，具有高度变化的特征。我们主要遵循[引用]的自回归训练设置和生成协议。

items.en: We benchmark the speed of the SSM scan operation (state expansion \(N=16\) ), as well as the end-to-end inference throughput of Mamba, in Figure˜12. Our efficient SSM scan is faster than the best attention implementation that we know of (FlashAttention-2 ) beyond sequence length 2K, and up to 20-40 \(\times\) faster than a standard scan implementation in PyTorch. Mamba achieves 4-5 \(\times\) higher inference throughput than a Transformer of similar size, since without the KV cache it can use much higher batch sizes. For example, a Mamba-6.9B (untrained) would have higher inference throughput than a \(5\times\) smaller Transformer-1.3B. Details in LABEL:sec:exp-details:benchmark, which additionally includes a benchmark of memory consumption.
items.zh: 我们在图˜12中对SSM扫描操作（状态扩展\(N=16\)）的速度以及Mamba的端到端推理吞吐量进行了基准测试。我们高效的SSM扫描在序列长度超过2K时，比我们所知的最佳注意力实现（FlashAttention-2）更快，且比PyTorch中的标准扫描实现快高达20-40\(\times\)。Mamba的推理吞吐量比相同大小的Transformer高出4-5\(\times\)，因为无需KV缓存，它可以利用更大的批大小。例如，一个Mamba-6.9B（未训练）的推理吞吐量将比小\(5\times\)的Transformer-1.3B更高。详见附录LABEL:sec:exp-details:benchmark，其中还包含了内存消耗的基准测试。

items.capEn: Figure 12: (Efficiency Benchmarks.) (Left) Training: our efficient scan is 40×40\times faster than a standard implementation. (Right) Inference: as a recurrent model, Mamba can achieve 5×5\times higher throughput than Transformers.

items.en: We perform a series of detailed ablations on components of our model, focusing on the setting of language modeling with size \(\approx 350\) M models at Chinchilla token counts (same setting as Figure˜6).
items.zh: 我们在模型组件上进行了一系列详细的消融实验，重点关注在Chinchilla令牌计数下（与图6相同设置）规模约为350M的语言模型设置。

items.en: Among previous non-selective (LTI) SSMs, which are equivalent to global convolutions, performance is very similar.
items.zh: 在之前的非选择性（LTI）SSM中，它们相当于全局卷积，性能非常相似。

items.en: Replacing the complex-valued S4 variant from previous work with a real-valued one does not affect performance much, suggesting that (at least for LM) real-valued SSMs may be a better choice when accounting for hardware efficiency.
items.zh: 将先前工作中的复值S4变体替换为实值变体对性能影响不大，这表明（至少对于LM而言）在考虑硬件效率时，实值SSM可能是更好的选择。

items.en: Replacing any of these with a selective SSM (S6) significantly improves performance, validating the motivation of Section 3.
items.zh: 将这些中的任何一个替换为选择性SSM（S6）都能显著提升性能，验证了第3节的动机。

items.en: The Mamba architecture performs similarly to the H3 architecture (and seems slightly better when using a selective layer).
items.zh: Mamba架构与H3架构表现相似（且在使用选择性层时似乎略优）。

items.en: We also investigate interleaving the Mamba block with other blocks such as MLP (a traditional architecture) and MHA (a hybrid attention architecture) in the experimental details section.
items.zh: 我们还研究了将Mamba模块与其他模块（如MLP（传统架构）和MHA（混合注意力架构））交错使用，具体见实验细节部分。

items.en: Of particular note is the dramatic improvement of the selective SSM when the state size \(N\) is increased, with over a 1.0 perplexity improvement for a cost of only 1% additional parameters. This validates our core motivation in Sections 3.1 and 3.3.
items.zh: 特别值得注意的是，当状态大小 \(N\) 增大时，选择性 SSM 的显著改进，仅以额外参数增加 1% 的代价就实现了超过 1.0 的困惑度改进。这验证了我们在第 3.1 节和第 3.3 节中的核心动机。

items.en: We discuss related work, limitations, and some future directions.
items.zh: 我们讨论了相关工作、局限性以及一些未来方向。

items.en: Section LABEL:sec:discussion:selection discusses how the selection mechanism relates to similar concepts. Section LABEL:sec:related has an extended related work of SSMs and other related models.
items.zh: 第 LABEL:sec:discussion:selection 节讨论了选择机制如何与类似概念相关联。第 LABEL:sec:related 节提供了 SSM 及其他相关模型的扩展相关工作。

items.en: Structured SSMs were originally defined as discretizations of continuous systems (Equation 1), and have had a strong inductive bias toward continuous-time data modalities such as perceptual signals (e.g., audio, video). As discussed in Sections 3.1 and 3.5, the selection mechanism overcomes their weaknesses on discrete modalities such as text and DNA; but this conversely can impede their performance on data that LTI SSMs excel on. Our ablations on audio waveforms examine this tradeoff in more detail.
items.zh: 结构化 SSM 最初被定义为连续系统的离散化（公式 1），并且对连续时间数据模态（例如音频、视频）具有很强的归纳偏置。如第 3.1 节和第 3.5 节所述，选择机制克服了其在离散模态（如文本和 DNA）上的弱点；但这反过来可能损害其在 LTI SSM 擅长数据上的性能。我们在音频波形上的消融实验更详细地研究了这种权衡。

items.en: Transformer-based foundation models (particularly LLMs) have a rich ecosystem of properties and modes of interaction with pretrained models, such as fine-tuning, adaptation, prompting, in-context learning, instruction tuning, RLHF, quantization, and so on. We are particularly interested in whether Transformer alternatives such as SSMs have similar properties and affordances.
items.zh: 基于 Transformer 的基础模型（特别是 LLM）拥有丰富的特性和与预训练模型交互的方式，例如微调、适配、提示、上下文学习、指令微调、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、量化等。我们特别感兴趣的是，Transformer 的替代品（如 SSM）是否具有类似的属性和可供性。

items.en: Our empirical evaluation is limited to small model sizes, below the threshold of most strong open source LLMs (e.g., Llama) as well as other recurrent models such as RWKV and RetNet, which have been evaluated at the 7B parameter scale and beyond. It remains to assess whether Mamba still compares favorably at these larger sizes. We also note that scaling SSMs may involve further engineering challenges and adjustments to the model that are not discussed in this paper.
items.zh: 我们的实证评估仅限于小模型规模，低于大多数强开源 LLM（例如 Llama）以及其他循环模型（如 RWKV 和 RetNet）的阈值，这些模型已经在 7B 参数规模及以上进行了评估。尚需评估 Mamba 在这些更大规模上是否仍然具有优势。我们还注意到，缩放 SSM 可能涉及本文未讨论的进一步工程挑战和模型调整。

items.en: We introduce a selection mechanism to structured state space models, allowing them to perform context-dependent reasoning while scaling linearly in sequence length. When incorporated into a simple attention-free architecture, Mamba achieves state-of-the-art results on a diverse set of domains, where it matches or exceeds the performance of strong Transformer models. We are excited about the broad applications of selective state space models to build foundation models for different domains, especially in emerging modalities requiring long context such as genomics, audio, and video. Our results suggest that Mamba is a strong candidate to be a general sequence model backbone.
items.zh: 我们将选择机制引入结构化状态空间模型，使其能够在序列长度上线性缩放的同时执行上下文相关推理。当融入一个简单的免注意力架构时，Mamba 在多个不同领域取得了最先进的结果，匹配或超越了强大 Transformer 模型的性能。我们对选择性状态空间模型在构建不同领域基础模型方面的广泛应用感到兴奋，尤其是在需要长上下文的新兴模态中，如基因组学、音频和视频。我们的结果表明，Mamba 是成为通用序列模型骨干的有力候选者。
